title: The Monkey and the Banana
summary: Little Monkey wakes up hungry and wants a banana, so he sets off to find one all by himself. Which animals will he meet along the way?
pages: Mother Monkey goes out to find food for Little Monkey.
Little Monkey wakes up and calls, "I'm so hungry! I want to eat a banana."
He decides to go and look for a banana by himself.
Little Monkey meets a snake and asks, "Snake, is there a banana tree around here?"
The snake answers, "No. I live in a hole and I have never seen one." Little Monkey says thank you to the snake and goes on.
Little Monkey keeps going and meets a tiger. "Tiger, are there any bananas here?"
The tiger answers, "No. I live in the big forest and I have never seen any." Little Monkey says thank you to the tiger and goes on.
Little Monkey keeps going and meets a fish. He asks, "Fish, are there any bananas here?"
The fish answers, "No. I live in the water and I have never seen any." Little Monkey says thank you to the fish. Now Little Monkey is really, really hungry.
Little Monkey keeps going and meets a heron. He asks, "Heron, are there any bananas here?"
The heron answers, "Yes. There are banana trees by the stream. I fly over them and always see them."
Little Monkey goes to the banana trees and sees his mother bringing bananas home.
Little Monkey is happy to see Mother and eats the yummy bananas.
